mirage.configuration.title: Mirage Configs
mirage.configuration.armadilloUnafraidAr: Whether armadillos are no longer afraid of mobs wearing armadillo chestplates
mirage.configuration.fadedTerracottaSmel: Whether glazed terracotta should be able to be smelted/blasted into faded terracotta (Reload Required)
mirage.configuration.fadedTerracottaCrea: Whether faded terracotta should be available in the creative inventory (Reload Required)
mirage.configuration.sherdCracking.toolt: Whether sherds should be able to be smelted into cracked sherds (Reload Required)
mirage.configuration.sherdCrafting.toolt: Whether sherds should be able to be crafted from blank sherds (Reload Required)
mirage.configuration.sherdRepairing.tool: Whether blank sherds should be able to be crafted from cracked sherds (Reload Required)
mirage.configuration.blankSherdConstruct: Whether blank sherds should be able to be crafted from basic materials (Reload Required)
mirage.configuration.sherdConstructing.t: Whether any sherd should be able to be crafted from basic materials (Reload Required)
